svg.title: TOPAK A5 — The command-chain overlay: a tree of planes that only narrows, an intent boundary above every effect, and a vehicle that is a governor and a stack
svg.desc: The custodian asked what follows if TOPAK is the top tier of a command chain, with control planes below it that only narrow ⟨1⟩. Ten records answer, drafted 2026.11.10: planes are seated down a tree under charters that only narrow (ADR-0059); every effect's authorizing admit is ordered at the intent boundary, the last commanded plane above a group of vehicles (ADR-0060); below it an autonomous plane of replicas on the vehicles' governors grants leases and changes no authority (ADR-0060, ADR-0061); a governor permits under a lease with no further round, and a vehicle that stops hearing its plane loses its lease (ADR-0062); revocation is bounded in effects, duration in ticks (ADR-0063, ADR-0064); stacks talk on declared topics and nothing a peer originates enables anything (ADR-0065); an irreversible effect is a person's (ADR-0066). Every one is Proposed, and an overlay, not the archetype ⟨Q11⟩. Nothing here is in force or built.
svg.text: TOPAK · A5

text.tspan: The command-chain overlay: a tree of planes that only narrows, an intent boundary above every effect, and a vehicle that is a governor and a stack

svg.text: The custodian asked what follows if TOPAK is the top tier of a command chain, with control planes below it that only narrow ⟨1⟩. Ten records answer, drafted 2026.11.10: planes are seated down a tree under charters that only narrow (ADR-0059); every effect's authorizing admit is ordered at the intent boundary, the last commanded plane above a group of vehicles (ADR-0060); below it an autonomous plane of replicas on the vehicles' governors grants leases and changes

no authority (ADR-0060, ADR-0061); a governor permits under a lease with no further round, and a vehicle that stops hearing its plane loses its lease (ADR-0062); revocation is bounded in effects, duration in ticks (ADR-0063, ADR-0064); stacks talk on declared topics and nothing a peer originates enables anything (ADR-0065); an irreversible effect is a person's (ADR-0066). Every one is Proposed, and an overlay, not the archetype ⟨Q11⟩. Nothing here is in force or built.

text.tspan: Proposed · C1 · provisional while ADR-0052 is
Checked: 321 TLC rows, all as expected
Certified, with 5 to 10 LS4 temporal steps that no checker confirms (52 in all)

svg.text: Proposed means nothing here is in force. The ten records were drafted in one day by one author from the custodian's decisions ⟨1⟩–⟨22⟩ and answers ⟨Q1⟩–⟨Q20⟩ (ADR-0059 Annex A), and ADR-0059 to ADR-0067 were revised R1 the same day to take the modules' findings; ADR-0068 has no R1 row. Each is an overlay ⟨Q11⟩: a deployment adds these nodes under ADR-0058 (Proposed) and reports them upstream as findings about the archetype, and a deployment with one plane is the corpus as it stands and takes nothing

from them (ADR-0059, deployment position). Checked is said of TLC rows at small constants, proved of TLAPS obligations, and certified only with its LS4 steps named; none of the three is said of running code, and none exists. ADR-0067 has no module (no Cedar is written) and ADR-0068 is declarative. The proof scan finds no capture in any of the eight proof modules (spec/proof-scan-results-2026.11.10.txt).

text.tspan: What each arrow is, and the record that defines it
① A charter, seated down the tree · ADR-0059 §1, §4, §5

svg.text: Seated by a promotion at the parent: the parent's tally votes it. Every field the parent's or narrower, compared before the vote, when applied, and by every verifier of the
chain.
Carries a commit certificate: a quorum of the issuing plane's replicas over its digest and log index. Crash-recovery consensus cannot supply one, so an exposed plane runs
Byzantine agreement ⟨Q7⟩.
A plane is a havoc issuer bounded by its charter. The chain check bounds what each lease may carry, and not how many a captured plane signs ⟨R1⟩.

text.tspan: ② An intent, ordered at the intent boundary · ADR-0060 §1, §2

svg.text: A charter for one round: a task, an envelope, an activation budget, and an expiry counted from a named tick (ADR-0064 §3); the first intent's from tick zero ⟨Q13⟩.
Ends at its expiry, when its budget is spent, when ended or revoked, or when any plane above is fenced. Ordered before the effect, and need not be live at it ⟨R1⟩.

text.tspan: ③ A lease, granted by the autonomous plane · ADR-0062 §2, §5, §7

svg.text: One round of the plane per lease, and none per entry ⟨21⟩ ⟨22⟩: the vehicle, the alphabet, the envelope, an exact count and a ttl in ticks.
Ends when its count is spent and its last extent has run, at its ttl, on revocation or a fence, and at once when the vehicle is alone. An ending grants nothing.

text.tspan: ④ The record up, watermarks down · ADR-0063 §1–§5

svg.text: The log and each sealed lease record go up while the link holds. A watermark comes down with a certificate and carries every fence, so a fence is pulled as well as
pushed.
A watermark releases what it covers. With the link cut the charge only grows and the plane stops before K_up: a cut link fails closed, with no premise about time.
Numbered from the charter, not from the tick before. A replica signs no tick ahead of its own clock and no grant while the next tick is due.
No grant more than one tick period past an expiry, under the premise that captured and slow replicas are fewer than a certificate: a declared bound, not a safety
theorem (§4).

text.tspan: ⑥ Peer topics, among governors · ADR-0065 §1–§4

svg.text: A send is a Report to a declared topic, permitted by the governor, not ordered and not charged to K_up. Receipt is ingress, labelled untrusted and by its topic ⟨Q19⟩.
Nobody is addressed.
Nothing a peer originates enables anything. A certified fact a peer relays is the plane's act.
The person composes and signs it ⟨Q5⟩, naming the entry, its inputs, the vehicle, the fences and a tick of the vehicle's plane. Ordered at the commanded plane and
delivered with its certificate.
The interlock fires it once, and only while fresh: no more than a declared number of ticks past the tick it names ⟨Q16⟩. Aged is a count of the plane's ticks ⟨R1⟩.

text.tspan: ⑧ A plane fence, pushed down · ADR-0059 §6

svg.text: Any plane that moves its epoch fences everything below it: a subtraction, ordered, needing no quorum. A charter and a lease carry the epoch and index of every plane on
the chain.
A fence travels as far as the link does, and by relay among governors (ADR-0065 §1). What bounds a plane it cannot reach is ADR-0063.

svg.text: Every ratification condition still owes its floor entries (ADR-0067), the reference, and a reader who is not the drafter (ADR-0029 A2); ADR-0059's also owes ADR-0058's ratification. This keeps ADR-0015's sentence one level up: every effect has a consensus-ordered, signed, authorizing predecessor, and here it is the intent. effects follow its end.

Subtraction: the end of a round, a revocation, an Observer's finding, expiry

A claim about an honest plane's log ⟨R1⟩. A captured plane is a havoc issuer: it can sign a lease under an intent that has ended, and what bounds it is the chain check and ADR-0063. It is a declared degeneracy and an
addition, not a second pattern ⟨Q2⟩: it omits Build, the people and Kafka, and its charters, commit certificates and operation with no person present are capabilities the archetype lacks (§4).

text.tspan: What each record reports upstream, and what the archetype's records would owe if it takes them (each record's overlay-position section; ADR-0058 §6)

svg.text: ADR-0023 §4: a variation that holds a capability the archetype lacks is not a rung, and the archetype is incomplete. So each record is drafted as an overlay's, and what it adds is reported upstream as a finding about the archetype. None of this is owed while it is an overlay: every record "carries a debt against nothing".

Five records would need C3 on admission (ADR-0059, ADR-0060, ADR-0061, ADR-0062, ADR-0066): each reverses or relaxes accepted text. ADR-0068's Options keep its rows out of ADR-0045 while this is an overlay, since ADR-0045 is accepted and an annex would amend it.

text.tspan: What is given up, in one place (ADR-0068 §4, whole)
Each record names its own costs. Together:

svg.text: Planes grant below themselves (ADR-0059).

text.tspan: 2. A bound in seconds as a theorem

svg.text: Revocation is bounded in effects, and the bound in duration is declared (ADR-0063, ADR-0064).

text.tspan: 3. An ordered admit before every effect

svg.text: For every pre-authorized entry and every report to a peer (ADR-0062, ADR-0065).
For a plane that is cut off (ADR-0060).

text.tspan: 5. Any act by a vehicle that is alone

svg.text: No principal seats, delegates to or addresses another, and that stays true. It is no longer true that

text.tspan: a person is always on the plane that orders an effect.

svg.text: Item 7's §2 is ADR-0068's own: twelve trusted-base rows, and "the base still grows, on every vehicle". For items 5, 6, 8 and 9 the record gives the title and the citation only.
